fr_html: Le PRESIDENT met aux voix l'article 25 du projet Root-Phillimore, avec l'addition dont Lord Phillimore vient de donner lecture.
en_html: The PRESIDENT put Article 25 of the Root—Phillimore plan to the vote, including the addition just read by Lord Phillimore.
